<div  class="module module-text tb_ykp3329   " data-lazy="1">
            <div  class="tb_text_wrap">
    <h1 class="no22_konaklama" style="text-align: center;"><strong>NO 22 RIDERS’ INN </strong> HOUSING</h1>
<hr />
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">Located just 45 minutes from Dalaman Airport, in the heart of Gökova – Akyaka, and within walking distance to Azmak River and the sea, No 22 Riders’ inn offers 14 rooms designed as a meeting and accommodation point for kitesurf and outdoor activity enthusiasts. <br/><br/>Thanks to its location, No 22 Riders’ inn keeps you close to the kite beach, dining spots, and local nightlife, while also offering a unique escape for those seeking a more nature-centered experience away from city life.</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">To learn about our current seasonal prices, make a reservation, or get information about transfers, kite lessons, and other activities, please fill out our contact form or reach us via phone or email.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
    </div>
</div>
